headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.14
summary: This release makes the update screen cover the whole display on devices with a notch: the update window was letterboxed away from the landscape cutout because its translucent theme prevented the cutout mode from applying, leaving a strip of the launcher visible next to the notch.

items.text: Fixed the update screen not going full screen on notched devices: the update window now extends into the display cutout area on Android 11+, so the black strip beside the landscape notch is gone while the content still keeps a safe distance from the cutout.
